name: A native progress bar (WinForms, msctls_progress32) moving while the focus stays on the button that started it, with JAWS's progress bar announcements at their default (ProgressBarUpdateInterval=5000): Space starts 10, 20 and 30 within 1.5 s, 40 at 8 s and 100 at 14 s, the button renamed Done; then Say Focus and Say Window
